reviews.text:
Excellent service! The groomer is always kind, professional, and attentive. We're so happy we found you!
Thank you 🫶🏼

I've been going to this salon regularly for over a year now and I'm still extremely satisfied. After many negative experiences, I found Francesca, who, in addition to being professionally trained, is extremely sweet and patient and doesn't give up until she's achieved a result she's satisfied with. She's my Pongo; they've become great friends, and even though they say all sorts of things, they always end with a big hug and a lick. Thank you for everything.
Very welcoming friendliness equal to the professionalism demonstrated
Thank you for your trust and the 5 stars! 🐾 It's a pleasure to take care of your four-legged friends. ❤️ …

I take my cat to Embassy of the Cuddles and I'm very happy with it. The staff is professional, kind, and takes great care of everything. They treat my cat with so much love and care, always making him feel at ease. It's truly reassuring to entrust him to such competent and passionate people. Highly recommended!

I've been taking my Maine Coon cat here every month and a half since she was six months old, because we keep her very clean at home. I see how rested and calm she always is, both because she's used to being handled and, above all, because of the groomers' expertise. They give excellent advice on how to handle her and how to get her used to the car. We've been loyal customers for almost a year now and will definitely be back again.
Very welcoming, the service was accurate, precise and kind, very good

My dog ​​is a bit wary and only lets me touch her, so the nail trimming was a complete failure! I have to compliment the woman, though. She immediately understood the situation and, with great kindness, explained to me step by step how to do the trimming at home so she could feel at ease. Putting your dog's well-being first really makes a difference.
Thank you
My Goddess and I had a great time. I recommend it to anyone who wants to find professionalism, kindness, honesty and lots of pampering.

If you go to the groomer with your furry child and the first thing he or she does is go crazy with joy and happiness when he or she sees the staff and barks because he or she wants to come into the shop, then this means only one thing: you've arrived at the embassy of cuddles! 🤩 Every time I go with my little girl, this happens exactly! Magic? ✨ Of course, that of Fransisca and Federica, who love animals beyond measure and transmit this love and passion during the grooming service, giving them all the attention they need. They are always smiling, cheerful, kind, helpful, and our four-legged friends always leave their shop clean, smelling good, cared for in every detail, full of cuddles and treats. The prices? More than fair for such a service! Thank you Fransisca and Federica, you are Hera's new step-aunts! 🐾 💖
Thanks to their professionalism, Federica and Francesca were able to clean our kitten for the first time in 5 years! They gave us both a relaxing morning. Thank you so much, we'll be back again.
Very sweet and kind both with dogs and with customers, meticulous in detail.
Fantastic! Always punctual, friendly, and efficient.
Very professional girls. My chocolate Labrador always comes back smelling great and clean with a shiny coat. Highly recommended.

Dear Fabio,
We're sorry to hear about this change in your rating, as you initially gave us 5 stars for our service.
We'd like to point out that for a long-haired Dutch Shepherd (with the resulting amount of work and removal of the undercoat accumulated over the year), the €50 fee is exactly what we listed, with no additional charge for the extra time spent.
We always strive to offer the highest quality at the right price, and we're happy that your dog was treated well.
Kind regards,
Ambasciata delle Coccole
After the third time we've brought our puppy, we can say we're very happy with the experience and appreciate the attention paid to our dog's needs and schedule. Thanks again for the valuable service.
Mrs. Francesca and the girl were super kind and knowledgeable! They are the best and I highly recommend them to everyone!!!!!
Professional and kind.

Excellent treatment for the dog, who is constantly pampered by the person washing him. The staff is kind and helpful, and they also offer excellent tips for cleaning at home. Furthermore, being able to watch the dog being washed from the window is essential; I would never leave him unattended. We'll be back soon.
